mapper.select:
select r.record_id, r.customer_id, r.source_type, r.source_delivery_id, r.source_order_id, d.delivery_date as source_delivery_date, br.route_name as source_route_name, r.original_amount, r.carried_amount, r.repaid_amount, (r.remaining_amount
+ coalesce(tc.current_carried_amount, 0)
) as remaining_amount, r.status, r.remark from biz_customer_debt_record r
left join ( select record_id, sum(amount) as current_carried_amount from biz_customer_debt_carry where target_order_id = #{targetOrderId} group by record_id ) tc on r.record_id = tc.record_id
left join biz_delivery_order d on r.source_delivery_id = d.delivery_id left join biz_route br on d.route_id = br.route_id where r.customer_id = #{customerId} and ( r.remaining_amount > 0
or coalesce(tc.current_carried_amount, 0) > 0
) and ( r.status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING')
or (r.status = 'CARRIED' and coalesce(tc.current_carried_amount, 0) > 0)
)
and (r.source_order_id is null or r.source_order_id != #{targetOrderId})
order by d.delivery_date asc, r.record_id asc
